scientific_integrity: The source W-maps and their stationary density are credited to Kalle and Maggioni; the proposed contribution is the exact stationary symbolic temporal-memory classification, not a new invariant density or a full-state decorrelation theorem.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the stationary natural four-cell coding and its center indicator.
No claim of uniqueness of the full-state stationary law for every parameter.
No quenched, nonstationary, or real-valued-state independence claim.
Independent publication-priority or correctness audit not performed.
title: An exact finite-memory resonance in random W-shaped interval maps
